Navigate a NestedScale's hierarchy

Source: R/navigate.R
scale_navigate.Rd

Codes related to member at another frame, found through the leaves. scale_children()/scale_parents() step one frame down/up by default; scale_descendants()/scale_ancestors() report every finer/coarser frame as a frame-tagged table.

Usage

scale_children(x, frame, member, target = NULL)

scale_parents(x, frame, member, target = NULL)

scale_descendants(x, frame, member, target = NULL)

scale_ancestors(x, frame, member, target = NULL)

Arguments

x

A NestedScale.

frame

The frame member belongs to.

member

Character vector of codes.

target

Target frame. NULL uses the adjacent frame (children/parents) or every finer/coarser frame (descendants/ancestors).

Value

A character vector (children/parents) or a data.frame with columns frame and member (descendants/ancestors).

Examples

s <- scale_example()
scale_children(s, "sector", "P")
#> [1] "G1" "G2"
scale_parents(s, "item", "U5")
#> [1] "GB"
scale_descendants(s, "sector", "P")
#>   frame member
#> 1 class     G1
#> 2 class     G2
#> 3 group     G1
#> 4 group     GB
#> 5  item     U1
#> 6  item     U2
#> 7  item     U3
#> 8  item     U4
scale_ancestors(s, "item", "U5")
#>    frame member
#> 1 sector      S
#> 2  class     S1
#> 3  group     GB
